$comment: Shared engine-neutral case table for the openapi family specifications §§9.2–9.3. Each case is rendered as a whole OpenAPI document and loaded through the engine harness. Outcomes distinguish source-refused, refused, missing-required-choice, and admitted emission. Corrected 2026-08-26: the superseded 2026-08-20 typeless-part refusal was removed. On the 3.1 line a typeless resolved multipart part defaults to application/octet-stream and uses the canonical-Base64 raw-octet boundary. On the 3.0 line it has no default and the consumer must supply configuration.propertyMedia; because this table supplies no configuration, those otherwise valid multipart cells decide missing-required-choice. A 3.0 boolean schema remains source-invalid under that line’s Schema Object dialect. Typeless urlencoded controls remain excluded because the family text defines no urlencoded raw-octet boundary. The emission rendering normalizes multipart parts as <Content-Type>:<body>, joins repeated parts with &, and uses error when the supplied application value cannot cross its selected lane.

cases.name: 3.0.0|multipart|typeless-empty-string-value
cases.basis: The openapi-3.0 family specification §9.3 states that a typeless resolved multipart declaration has no default concrete part type and that configuration.propertyMedia is required for that affected property. This engine-neutral table supplies no configuration, so the represented alternative reaches the missing-required-choice decision; no application value is inspected.

cases.name: 3.0.0|multipart|boolean-literal-true
cases.basis: F-O1-13. OAS 3.0.0's Schema Object is the Wright Draft 00 subset, in which a `properties` member is a Schema Object and the JSON Schema boolean-literal schemas are not in the dialect. The spelling is therefore a defect, not a declaration: the acceptance floor classifies it at the position that carries it and confines it to the request media alternative that owns it (accounted `invalid`, never a whole-source refusal). The decision this table records is only that the part carries nothing; the `invalid` accounting is pinned by acceptance-floor-case-table.json's F-O1-13 shape cells.

cases.name: 3.0.0|urlencoded|typeless-empty-string-value
cases.basis: OA-F8 (2026-09-03): on the 3.0 line no accepted edition states a default contentType row reaching a part declaring no `type` (3.0.0-3.0.3 enumerate string-with-format-binary, other primitive types, object and array with no catch-all; 3.0.4 tabulates the same cases keyed on a declared `type`), and openbindings.openapi-3.0@1 Section 9.3 requires `propertyMedia` for such a declaration "on the content-based form-urlencoded path and for a multipart part alike". The engines had honoured that sentence on multipart only; the urlencoded twin now reads the same. This harness supplies no configuration, so the represented alternative reaches missing-required-choice before inspecting the value. Previously read `refused`.
